entities.summary: Joachim Christian Geelmuyden Gyldenkrantz Frich was a Norwegian landscape painter. He was associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting (Düsseldorf-skolen). Joachim Frich was a painters & sculptors from Bergen (1810-07-17, Bergen–1858-01-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
